description: This file defines the OpenmrsMetadata interface, which represents metadata objects in the OpenMRS data model, including methods for handling name, description, and change tracking metadata.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metadata object.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the metadata object.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the metadata object.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the metadata object.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who made the last change to the metadata object (deprecated).

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who made the last change to the metadata object (deprecated).

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the metadata was last changed (deprecated).

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the metadata was last changed (deprecated).
